title: "Tidy Tuesday"
output: html_document
date: "2026-05-04"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytuesdayR)
library(janitor)
library(tinytable)
library(maps)
library(ggthemes)
library(patchwork)

# Download TidyTuesday data
tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load("2026-05-12")

# Find what datasets are present for this week
names(tuesdata)

# Name datasets
cities <- tuesdata$cities
links <- tuesdata$links

readme(tuesdata)
```

```{r view-data, warning=FALSE}
# View the structure of each dataset
glimpse(cities)
glimpse(links)

links_annotated <- links %>%
  left_join(cities %>%
              select(id, name, country, continent, lat, lng), 
            by = c("source" = "id")) %>%
  rename(source_name = name, source_country = country,
         source_continent = continent, source_lat = lat, source_lng = lng) %>%
  left_join(cities %>%
              select(id, name, country, continent, lat, lng), 
            by = c("target" = "id")) %>%
  rename(target_name = name, target_country = country, target_continent = continent, target_lat = lat, target_lng = lng)
```

```{r exploring, warning=FALSE}
bind_rows(
  links %>%
    count(city_id = source),
  links %>%
    count(city_id = target)
) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n), .by = city_id) %>%
  left_join(cities %>%
              select(id, name, country), by = c("city_id" = "id")) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 10)

links_annotated %>%
  filter(source_country == "Pakistan" | target_country == "Pakistan") %>%
  mutate(
    pak_city = if_else(source_country == "Pakistan", source_name, target_name),
    partner_city = if_else(source_country == "Pakistan", target_name, source_name),
    partner_country = if_else(source_country == "Pakistan", target_country, source_country)
  ) %>%
  select(pak_city, partner_city, partner_country) %>%
  arrange(pak_city)
```

```{r data-prep, warning=FALSE}
# world map data
world <- map_data("world")

country_colors <- world %>%
  distinct(region) %>%
  mutate(color_group = as.factor(as.integer(factor(region)) %% 6))

world_colored <- world %>%
  left_join(country_colors, by = "region")

# pakistan links with coordinates
pak_links <- links_annotated %>%
  filter(source_country == "Pakistan" | target_country == "Pakistan") %>%
  mutate(
    pak_city = if_else(source_country == "Pakistan", source_name, target_name),
    partner_city = if_else(source_country == "Pakistan", target_name, source_name),
    partner_country = if_else(source_country == "Pakistan", target_country, source_country),
    pak_lat = if_else(source_country == "Pakistan", source_lat, target_lat),
    pak_lng = if_else(source_country == "Pakistan", source_lng, target_lng),
    partner_lat = if_else(source_country == "Pakistan", target_lat, source_lat),
    partner_lng = if_else(source_country == "Pakistan", target_lng, source_lng)
  )
```

```{r graph, warning=FALSE}

# --- main map ---
main_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = world_colored,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = color_group),
    color = "white", linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "0" = "#d4e6c3", "1" = "#c3d4e6", "2" = "#e6c3d4",
      "3" = "#e6d4c3", "4" = "#c3e6e0", "5" = "#d4c3e6"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = pak_links,
    aes(x = pak_lng, y = pak_lat, xend = partner_lng, yend = partner_lat),
    color = "black", alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_point(data = pak_links, aes(x = partner_lng, y = partner_lat),
             color = "black", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = pak_links, aes(x = pak_lng, y = pak_lat),
             color = "#c0392b", size = 0.8) +
  coord_fixed(1.3) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#fdfdf7", color = NA),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 8, color = "grey50",
                                margin = margin(b = 10, r = 10)),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold",
                              margin = margin(t = 15, b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, color = "grey40",
                                 margin = margin(b = 10))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Pakistan's Twin City Connections",
    subtitle = "Lines show twinning relationships between Pakistani cities and their global partners",
    caption = "Source: TidyTuesday 2026-05-12 | Pakistan's Twin City Connections"
  )

# --- inset: zoomed into Pakistan ---
inset <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = world_colored,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = color_group),
    color = "white", linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "0" = "#d4e6c3", "1" = "#c3d4e6", "2" = "#e6c3d4",
      "3" = "#e6d4c3", "4" = "#c3e6e0", "5" = "#d4c3e6"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  geom_point(data = pak_links, aes(x = pak_lng, y = pak_lat),
             color = "#c0392b", size = 1.5) +
geom_text(
  data = pak_links %>%
    distinct(pak_city, pak_lng, pak_lat) %>%
    mutate(
      nudge_x = case_when(
        pak_city == "Muzaffarabad" ~ -0.5,
        pak_city == "Peshawar"    ~ -0.5,
        pak_city == "Faisalabad"   ~ -0.5,
        TRUE ~ 0.3
      ),
      nudge_y = case_when(
        pak_city == "Muzaffarabad" ~ 0.3,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      hjust = case_when(
        pak_city %in% c("Muzaffarabad", "Peshawar", "Faisalabad") ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ -0.1
      ),
    ),
  aes(x = pak_lng + nudge_x, y = pak_lat + nudge_y, label = pak_city, hjust = hjust),
  size = 2.5, color = "grey20") +
  coord_fixed(1.4, xlim = c(61, 79), ylim = c(24, 37)) +  # zoom to Pakistan
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey40", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#fdfdf7", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.8)
  )

# --- combine with patchwork ---
main_map + inset_element(inset, left = 0.0, bottom = 0.0, right = 0.33, top = 0.43)

```
